question: I'm a CS 5th-year student. I completed 15-440 (Distributed Systems) in Fall 2023. Assuming I earned a B in 15-440, can I now register for 15-410 (Operating System Design and Implementation)?
expected_answer: Yes — 15-410 requires a grade of B or better in one of: 15-411, 15-418, 18-447, 15-441, 15-445, or 15-440. P-009 completed 15-440 and (assuming a B) meets this threshold. Academic warning does not block standard course registration.
reasoning_type: Grade-gated prerequisite with multiple acceptable alternatives
common_mistake: Not recognizing that 15-410 requires specifically a B (not just a passing grade) in the prerequisite; only checking one alternative prerequisite option
needs_verification: Confirm P-009's actual grade in 15-440 (must be B or better)
Confirm 15-410 is offered at CMU-Q (may be Pittsburgh-only)
Confirm 15-410 prerequisite list is current and includes 15-440
